rollback_limit: Before bytes and immutable object binding are preserved, but the old source clock is already expired. Restoring that pointer would restore an expired source; it must not be represented as healthy or restamped. Any rollback needs exact separate authorization and readback.
planned_after_verification: Existing promote: exact pointer JSON and immutable body SHA256/MD5, existing accepted transport ETag, unchanged Worker metadata.
After fresh exact parent approval only: one native Google Update and exact source count/time/delta readback.
guardrails: No blocked public URL or GCS retry.
No Worker, security, scheduler or credential change.
Any auth/permission/schema or uncertain PUT stops dependent actions; no blind write retry.
